Terumo Corporation
manufactures a wide array of medical devices, equipment, and consumables. Their core product categories include
injection and infusion tools (such as I.V. catheters and safety needles), cardiovascular surgery systems (heart-lung machines and oxygenators), interventional and neurovascular devices (guidewires, microcatheters, and stents), blood collection and apheresis systems, and general hospital supplies like digital thermometers
www.terumotmp.com
Major Product Groups
Infusion & Injection:
Safety needles (SurGuard), winged infusion sets (SurFlo), and I.V. catheters (SurFlash).
Cardiovascular Systems:
Artificial heart-lung machines, oxygenators, perfusion circuits, and cannula.
Interventional Devices:
Angiographic and coronary guidewires, balloon catheters, micro-guide catheters, and vascular closure devices.
Neurovascular Products:
Flow diverters (FRED), embolic coils, and support catheters for brain vascular diseases.
Blood & Cell Technologies:
Automated blood collection, therapeutic apheresis, and cell processing systems.
General Medical/Home Care:
Digital thermometers and blood glucose monitoring systems.
